lines.beaver: 민지야, 어제 전시회 잘 다녀왔어? 어땠어?
lines.beaver_en: Minji, did you enjoy the exhibition yesterday? How was it?
lines.beaver_roman: Minjiya, eoje jeonsihoe jal danyeowasseo? Eottaesseo?
lines.learner: 응, 미술관에서 미술 전시를 봤어. 정말 좋았어.
lines.en: Yeah, I saw an art exhibition at the art museum. It was great.
lines.roman: Eung, misulgwaneseo misul jeonsireul bwasseo. Jeongmal joasseo.

lines.beaver_en: Were there many people? How much was admission?
lines.learner: 만 원이었어. 평일인데도 사람이 정말 많았어.
lines.en: It was 10,000 won. Even though it was a weekday, it was really crowded.
lines.roman: Man wonieosseo. Pyeongirindedo sarami jeongmal manasseo.

lines.beaver_en: Which work do you remember most?
lines.learner: 무용 비디오를 상영했는데, 그게 제일 좋았어.
lines.en: They screened a dance video, and that was the best.
lines.roman: Muyong bidioreul sangyeonghaenneunde, geuge jeil joasseo.

lines.beaver: 와, 좋았겠다. 나는 어제 공연장에 갔어.
lines.beaver_en: Wow, sounds nice. I went to a concert hall yesterday.
lines.beaver_roman: Wa, joatgetda. Naneun eoje gongyeonjange gasseo.
lines.en: Really? What performance was it? An opera?

lines.beaver_en: No, it was a concert. A famous celebrity was there too.
lines.en: Wow! How was the stage? The playing was good too, right?

lines.beaver: 응, 무대가 멋있었어. 북 연주가 최고였어.
lines.beaver_en: Yeah, the stage was cool. The drum performance was the best.
lines.beaver_roman: Eung, mudaega meosisseosseo. Buk yeonjuga choegoyeosseo.
lines.en: The audience must have clapped a lot.

lines.beaver: 그런데 중간에 마이크가 안 나왔어. 어휴.
lines.beaver_en: But in the middle, the microphone stopped working. Ugh.
lines.beaver_roman: Geureonde junggane maikeuga an nawasseo. Eohyu.
lines.en: Oh no! Even as a celebrity, they must have panicked.

lines.beaver: 근데 사회자가 농담을 해서 코미디 쇼 같았어.
lines.beaver_en: But the MC told jokes, so it felt like a comedy show.
lines.beaver_roman: Geunde sahoejaga nongdameul haeseo komidi syo gatasseo.
lines.en: Haha, the MC was the real star then.

lines.beaver: 맞아. 끝나고 시디도 샀어. 같이 들을래?
lines.beaver_en: Right. I bought the CD afterward. Want to listen together?
lines.beaver_roman: Maja. Kkeunnago sidido sasseo. Gachi deureullae?
lines.learner: 좋아! 다음 공연은 나도 같이 관람하고 싶어.
lines.en: Sure! I want to watch the next performance with you.
lines.roman: Joa! Daeum gongyeoneun nado gachi gwallamhago sipeo.

lines.beaver: 그래, 다음 달에 같이 가자. 약속!
lines.beaver_en: Okay, let's go together next month. Promise!
lines.beaver_roman: Geurae, daeum dare gachi gaja. Yaksok!
lines.en: Yeah, promise! Let's go to the art museum together too!
